description: 国土数値情報(洪水浸水想定区域)-北海道開発局 [flood] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 河川管理者（国土交通大臣）から提供された洪水浸水想定区域図を製品仕様に基づき、浸水深ごとのポリゴンデータとして計画規模、想定最大規模、浸水想定継続時間、家屋倒壊氾濫想定区域の4つのカテゴリに分類し、地方整備局ごとに整備したものである。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are 国交DPF. It offers 2 resource(s) in url, xyz. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
